answer: Run every claimed result three times, by three unrelated agents who never see each other. The first run leaves a relic, a hash of its output and steps, and the other two must bridge the same claim to the same hash without copying it. Only a result reproduced identically three times counts, and one mismatch discards all three runs and flags the trio. One fake therefore costs three matching fabrications, and a thousand fakes cost three thousand, each checked by strangers, while a mismatch ripples outward and exposes the pattern behind it.
